name: Chris Workplace 1000
description: 1000 meanings for shop, project, business, and everyday English in Hong Kong.

senses.glossEn: A hand tool with a toothed blade, used for cutting wood or other hard material.
senses.glossTc: 有鋸齒的手工具，用來鋸開木材或其他硬物。

examples.en: We should use a saw after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「use a saw」。

examples.en: A customer asked about a circular saw.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「a circular saw」。

examples.en: He used a saw to cut the shelf to size.
examples.tc: 他用鋸子把層板鋸成所需長度。

examples.en: The hardware shop near the MTR sold us a new saw.
examples.tc: 港鐵站附近的五金店賣了一把新鋸給我們。

examples.en: Keep the saw off the till counter after you finish the display.
examples.tc: 做完陳列後，不要把鋸子放在收銀櫃台上。

synonyms.difference: A handsaw is one common type of saw, not every cutting tool.

senses.glossEn: Past tense of see: noticed or looked at someone or something.
senses.glossTc: see 的過去式：看見或注意到某人或某物。

examples.en: Please saw him before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「saw him」。

examples.en: Please saw the problem before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「saw the problem」。

examples.en: I saw the email this morning but have not replied yet.
examples.tc: 我今早看到那封電郵，但還未回覆。

examples.en: She saw the queue from the street and came in later.
examples.tc: 她在街上看到排隊，於是稍後才進來。

examples.en: We saw the supplier at the station after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我們在車站遇見供應商。

senses.glossEn: To look at written words and understand their meaning.
senses.glossTc: 看文字並理解其意思。

examples.en: We should read the report after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「read the report」。

examples.en: Can you read carefully for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「read carefully」嗎？

examples.en: Please read the contract before you sign it.
examples.tc: 請先閱讀合約，再簽署。

examples.en: I read WhatsApp slowly when the train is crowded.
examples.tc: 港鐵擠迫時，我會慢慢看 WhatsApp。

examples.en: Can you read the till message to the customer?
examples.tc: 你可以把收銀機上的訊息讀給顧客聽嗎？

synonyms.difference: Go through often means examine in detail, not only decode the words.

senses.glossEn: Past tense of read: finished looking at and understanding a text.
senses.glossTc: read 的過去式：已經看過並理解某段文字。

examples.en: Please read it yesterday before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「read it yesterday」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention already read.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「already read」。

examples.en: I read your proposal last night and marked two questions.
examples.tc: 我昨晚已讀過你的建議書，並標了兩個問題。

examples.en: He read the WhatsApp from the supplier before opening the shop.
examples.tc: 開店前他已看過供應商的 WhatsApp。

examples.en: They read the refund policy on the till screen.
examples.tc: 他們在收銀機螢幕上看過退款政策。

senses.glossEn: A business that keeps money, makes payments, and lends money.
senses.glossTc: 保管金錢、處理付款及借貸的機構。

examples.en: I will go to the bank after the supplier meeting.
examples.tc: 供應商會議後我會去銀行。

examples.en: I will open a bank account once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「open a bank account」。

examples.en: The shop pays takings into the bank every evening.
examples.tc: 店舖每晚都會把營業額存入銀行。

examples.en: The bank closed the counter before we reached the queue.
examples.tc: 我們排到之前，銀行櫃位已關門。

examples.en: Put bank on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「bank」寫進下午清單。

synonyms.difference: A lender may be a bank, but a bank also holds deposits and runs accounts.

senses.glossEn: The land along the side of a river or canal.
senses.glossTc: 河或運河兩旁的岸邊土地。

examples.en: We walked along the river bank after lunch.
examples.tc: 午飯後我們沿河岸散步。

examples.en: Write along the bank on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「along the bank」寫在白板上。

examples.en: The cafe on the bank is a short walk from the MTR.
examples.tc: 河岸那間茶餐廳由港鐵走一小段就到。

examples.en: Do not leave the delivery boxes on the wet bank.
examples.tc: 不要把送貨紙箱留在潮濕的岸邊。

examples.en: Put bank on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「bank」寫進下午清單。

synonyms.difference: Shore is more often used for a sea or lake than a river.

senses.glossEn: To shut something, or to bring a matter to an end.
senses.glossTc: 關上某物，或把一件事結束。

examples.en: Can you close the door for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「close the door」嗎？

examples.en: We should close the case after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「close the case」。

examples.en: Please close the till before you leave the shop.
examples.tc: 離開店舖前請關好收銀機。

examples.en: We will close the complaint after the refund is paid.
examples.tc: 退款完成後，我們會把投訴結案。

examples.en: Close the WhatsApp chat if the supplier has confirmed.
examples.tc: 若供應商已確認，便可結束該 WhatsApp 對話。

synonyms.difference: Shut is usually physical. Close can also end a deal or a file.

senses.glossEn: Near in space, time, or relationship.
senses.glossTc: 在距離、時間或關係上接近。

examples.en: The warehouse is close to the MTR station.
examples.tc: 貨倉鄰近港鐵站。

examples.en: She is a close friend of the shop owner.
examples.tc: 她是店主的好友。

examples.en: The deadline is close, so send the update tonight.
examples.tc: 截止日期臨近，今晚請把最新情況寄出。

examples.en: Keep the wording close in the shop notice.
examples.tc: 店舖告示的用字要保持「close」。

examples.en: Ask a colleague if close is needed today.
examples.tc: 問同事今天是否需要「close」。

synonyms.difference: Near is mainly about distance. Close can also describe a relationship.

senses.glossEn: To arrange in advance to have a place, time, or service.
senses.glossTc: 預先安排位置、時間或服務。

examples.en: I will book a room once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「book a room」。

examples.en: I will book a slot once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「book a slot」。

examples.en: Can you book a meeting room for Thursday morning?
examples.tc: 你能否預訂星期四上午的會議室？

examples.en: I booked a table near the MTR after work.
examples.tc: 下班後我在港鐵站附近訂了枱。

examples.en: Please book the courier before the till closes.
examples.tc: 請在收銀機關機前預訂速遞。

synonyms.difference: Reserve is slightly more formal; both can mean hold a place.

senses.glossEn: To examine something so you know it is correct or complete.
senses.glossTc: 檢查某事物，確認它正確或齊全。

examples.en: I will check the figures once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「check the figures」。

examples.en: A customer asked about double-check.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「double-check」。

examples.en: Check the stock count before we open tomorrow.
examples.tc: 明天開店前先核對存貨數目。

examples.en: I will check WhatsApp for the supplier's reply.
examples.tc: 我會查看 WhatsApp，看供應商有沒有回覆。

examples.en: Please check the till tape against the cash drawer.
examples.tc: 請把收銀機紙帶與錢箱核對。

synonyms.difference: Verify stresses proving that something is true, not only looking at it.

senses.glossEn: To give attention to a problem and start dealing with it.
senses.glossTc: 正視問題並着手處理。

examples.en: I will address the issue once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「address the issue」。

examples.en: Please address a concern before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「address a concern」。

examples.en: We need to address the delay before it affects the launch.
examples.tc: 我們要先處理延誤，以免影響推出時間。

examples.en: The meeting will address the customer queue at lunch.
examples.tc: 會議會處理午飯時顧客排隊的問題。

examples.en: Please address the WhatsApp complaint today.
examples.tc: 請今天處理該則 WhatsApp 投訴。

synonyms.difference: Deal with is more general. Address often names the issue first.

senses.glossEn: Happening or being used now.
senses.glossTc: 現正發生或現正使用的。

examples.en: A customer asked about current version.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「current version」。

examples.en: Write current customer on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「current customer」寫在白板上。

examples.en: The current price list replaces last month's version.
examples.tc: 現行價目表已取代上個月的版本。

examples.en: What is the current waiting time at the till?
examples.tc: 現時收銀處的等候時間是多久？

examples.en: Save the current file before you leave the MTR.
examples.tc: 離開港鐵前先儲存目前這個檔案。

synonyms.difference: Present can also mean in the room. Current usually means latest.

senses.glossEn: The speaker or writer; used to talk about yourself.
senses.glossTc: 說話或書寫的人用來指自己。

examples.en: I will send the file after lunch.
examples.tc: 我午飯後會把檔案寄出。

examples.en: A customer asked about I think.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「I think」。

examples.en: I can cover the till until six.
examples.tc: 我可以看收銀看到六時。

examples.en: I saw the supplier on the MTR this morning.
examples.tc: 我今早在港鐵見到供應商。

examples.en: Put I on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「I」寫進下午清單。

senses.glossEn: The person or people being spoken or written to.
senses.glossTc: 指正在對話或收信的對方。

examples.en: You can pay at the till or by FPS.
examples.tc: 你可以在收銀處付款，或用轉數快。

examples.en: Thank you for waiting near the door.
examples.tc: 謝謝你在門口附近等候。

examples.en: Can you confirm the delivery time?
examples.tc: 你能否確認送貨時間？

examples.en: Put you on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「you」寫進下午清單。

examples.en: Ask a colleague if you is needed today.
examples.tc: 問同事今天是否需要「you」。

senses.glossEn: The speaker and at least one other person.
senses.glossTc: 指自己連同至少另一人。

examples.en: We should test the till before Saturday.
examples.tc: 我們應在星期六前先測試收銀機。

examples.en: Today's notes mention we need.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「we need」。

examples.en: We can meet the supplier after the MTR rush.
examples.tc: 我們可以在港鐵繁忙時段過後見供應商。

examples.en: We sent the WhatsApp update before the deadline.
examples.tc: 我們在截止日期前已把 WhatsApp 最新情況寄出。

examples.en: Put we on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「we」寫進下午清單。

senses.glossEn: People or things already known in the conversation, not you or me.
senses.glossTc: 指對話中已知、但不是你或我的人或事物。

examples.en: They asked for a refund this afternoon.
examples.tc: 他們今天下午要求退款。

examples.en: Today's notes mention they said.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「they said」。

examples.en: They will approve the discount after the meeting.
examples.tc: 他們會在會議後批准折扣。

examples.en: If they miss the MTR, the delivery will be late.
examples.tc: 若他們趕不上港鐵，送貨便會遲到。

examples.en: Put they on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「they」寫進下午清單。

senses.glossEn: To make a process simpler and faster by removing extra steps.
senses.glossTc: 精簡流程，去掉多餘步驟，使其更快捷。

examples.en: Please streamline the process before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「streamline the process」。

examples.en: We should streamline approval after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「streamline approval」。

examples.en: We should streamline the approval process before automating it.
examples.tc: 我們應先簡化審批流程，再將其自動化。

examples.en: Streamline the refund steps so the till is not blocked.
examples.tc: 精簡退款步驟，以免收銀機被堵住。

examples.en: The shop streamlined WhatsApp orders last month.
examples.tc: 店舖上個月精簡了 WhatsApp 訂貨流程。

synonyms.difference: Simplify can mean make easier to understand. Streamline usually means remove delay from a process.

senses.glossEn: A series of steps used to get a result at work.
senses.glossTc: 為達成結果而設的一連串步驟。

examples.en: A customer asked about approval process.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「approval process」。

examples.en: The briefing covered work process.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「work process」。

examples.en: The refund process takes two working days.
examples.tc: 退款流程需時兩個工作天。

examples.en: Write the process on one page before the meeting.
examples.tc: 開會前先把流程寫成一頁。

examples.en: This process needs approval from the shop owner.
examples.tc: 此流程需要店主審批。

synonyms.difference: A procedure is often a written rule. A process is the work as it actually happens.

senses.glossEn: To officially agree that something may go ahead.
senses.glossTc: 正式同意某事可以進行。

examples.en: We should approve a request after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「approve a request」。

examples.en: I will approve the budget once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「approve the budget」。

examples.en: The manager will approve the discount if it stays under ten percent.
examples.tc: 只要折扣不超過一成，經理便會批准。

examples.en: Please approve the overtime before Friday's deadline.
examples.tc: 請在星期五截止日期前批准加班。

examples.en: They approved the supplier after the sample meeting.
examples.tc: 樣本會議後他們批准了該供應商。

synonyms.difference: Authorise stresses giving permission. Approve can also mean judge something as acceptable.

senses.glossEn: The latest time by which work must be finished.
senses.glossTc: 工作必須完成的最後期限。

examples.en: Please meet the deadline before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「meet the deadline」。

examples.en: I will miss a deadline once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「miss a deadline」。

examples.en: The report deadline is Friday at 5 p.m.
examples.tc: 報告截止日期是星期五下午五時。

examples.en: Tell the supplier the deadline in WhatsApp tonight.
examples.tc: 今晚用 WhatsApp 告訴供應商截止日期。

examples.en: We moved the till upgrade deadline after the holiday.
examples.tc: 假期後我們把收銀系統升級的截止日期延後。

synonyms.difference: Due date is common for bills and homework. Deadline is common for work tasks.

senses.glossEn: A person or group affected by a project and able to influence it.
senses.glossTc: 受項目影響、亦能影響項目的人或團體。

examples.en: The landlord is a key stakeholder for the shop works.
examples.tc: 業主是店舖工程的主要持份者。

examples.en: Today's notes mention stakeholder meeting.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「stakeholder meeting」。

examples.en: Shop staff are stakeholders in the new till system.
examples.tc: 店舖同事也是新收銀系統的持份者。

examples.en: Invite every stakeholder to Friday's meeting.
examples.tc: 邀請每位持份者出席星期五的會議。

examples.en: Put stakeholder on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「stakeholder」寫進下午清單。

synonyms.difference: Interested party is legal wording. Stakeholder is everyday project language.

senses.glossEn: What a project will and will not include.
senses.glossTc: 項目包括和不包括的範圍。

examples.en: The briefing covered project scope.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「project scope」。

examples.en: Write out of scope on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「out of scope」寫在白板上。

examples.en: Training videos are outside the scope of this week's work.
examples.tc: 培訓影片不在本週工作範圍內。

examples.en: Keep the new shelves inside the agreed scope.
examples.tc: 新層架須保持在已同意的範圍內。

examples.en: The customer app is not in scope until approval.
examples.tc: 未獲審批前，顧客應用程式不在範圍內。

synonyms.difference: Range is general size. Scope names agreed project boundaries.

senses.glossEn: A possible problem that could harm a plan if it happens.
senses.glossTc: 一旦發生便可能損害計劃的潛在問題。

examples.en: We should manage risk after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「manage risk」。

examples.en: A customer asked about high risk.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「high risk」。

examples.en: Late stock delivery is the main risk this month.
examples.tc: 貨物遲送是本月的主要風險。

examples.en: A long queue is a risk to the Saturday experience.
examples.tc: 排隊過長會影響星期六的顧客體驗，構成風險。

examples.en: Write the cash risk in the meeting notes.
examples.tc: 把現金風險寫進會議紀錄。

synonyms.difference: A threat is often more hostile. A risk can be an ordinary delay or cost.

senses.glossEn: To give the latest information, or to change something so it is current.
senses.glossTc: 提供最新資料，或把事物改成最新狀態。

examples.en: Please update the team after you speak to the supplier.
examples.tc: 與供應商談完後，請向團隊匯報最新情況。

examples.en: We should update the file after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「update the file」。

examples.en: Update the till prices before we open.
examples.tc: 開店前先更新收銀機價錢。

examples.en: I will update you on WhatsApp when the MTR is clear.
examples.tc: 港鐵不擠時，我會用 WhatsApp 向你匯報。

examples.en: We can update this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「update」。

synonyms.difference: Inform can be any news. Update means the news is newer than before.

senses.glossEn: A planned time when people talk about work together.
senses.glossTc: 預先安排、一起討論工作的時間。

examples.en: A customer asked about hold a meeting.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「hold a meeting」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention meeting agenda.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「meeting agenda」。

examples.en: The supplier meeting starts at ten.
examples.tc: 供應商會議十時開始。

examples.en: We held a short meeting beside the till after closing.
examples.tc: 關門後我們在收銀處旁開了短會。

examples.en: The team asked how meeting works here: 預先安排、一起討論工作的時間。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「meeting」怎麼用：預先安排、一起討論工作的時間。

synonyms.difference: A discussion can be informal. A meeting is usually scheduled.

senses.glossEn: A finished piece of work that you have promised to hand over.
senses.glossTc: 已承諾要交出的完成工作成果。

examples.en: Today's notes mention project deliverable.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「project deliverable」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention key deliverable.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「key deliverable」。

examples.en: The first deliverable is a one-page process map.
examples.tc: 第一項交付成果是一頁流程圖。

examples.en: The till training notes are this week's deliverable.
examples.tc: 收銀培訓筆記是本週的交付成果。

examples.en: Send each deliverable to the stakeholder before Friday.
examples.tc: 星期五前把每項交付成果寄給持份者。

synonyms.difference: Output is any result. A deliverable is an agreed hand-over.

senses.glossEn: A person who buys goods or services from a shop or business.
senses.glossTc: 向店舖或公司購買貨品或服務的人。

examples.en: A regular customer asked about the new opening hours.
examples.tc: 一位熟客詢問新的營業時間。

examples.en: The briefing covered customer service.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「customer service」。

examples.en: The customer waited at the till with a WhatsApp voucher.
examples.tc: 顧客拿着 WhatsApp 優惠券在收銀處等候。

examples.en: Thank the customer before you pack the bag.
examples.tc: 裝袋前先向顧客道謝。

examples.en: Put customer on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「customer」寫進下午清單。

synonyms.difference: Client is more common for professional services. Customer is more common in shops.

senses.glossEn: A bill that lists what was sold and how much must be paid.
senses.glossTc: 列出已售項目及應付款額的帳單。

examples.en: Please send an invoice before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「send an invoice」。

examples.en: I will pay the invoice once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「pay the invoice」。

examples.en: Please send the invoice to the accounts email.
examples.tc: 請把發票寄到會計電郵。

examples.en: The supplier WhatsApped a photo of the invoice.
examples.tc: 供應商用 WhatsApp 傳了發票相片。

examples.en: Check the invoice against the till delivery note.
examples.tc: 請把發票與收銀處的送貨單核對。

synonyms.difference: Bill is everyday. Invoice is the formal document used between businesses.

senses.glossEn: Money a business receives from sales before costs are taken off.
senses.glossTc: 扣除成本前，生意從銷售收到的金錢。

examples.en: Today's notes mention monthly revenue.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「monthly revenue」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention revenue target.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「revenue target」。

examples.en: Weekend revenue rose after we extended opening hours.
examples.tc: 延長營業時間後，週末收入上升。

examples.en: Till revenue dropped when the MTR exit was closed.
examples.tc: 港鐵出口關閉時，收銀營業額下跌。

examples.en: The team asked how revenue works here: 扣除成本前，生意從銷售收到的金錢。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「revenue」怎麼用：扣除成本前，生意從銷售收到的金錢。

synonyms.difference: Income can include wages or rent. Revenue usually means sales money.

senses.glossEn: A written plan offered for other people to accept or reject.
senses.glossTc: 供對方接受或拒絕的書面計劃。

examples.en: I will write a proposal once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「write a proposal」。

examples.en: The briefing covered accept a proposal.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「accept a proposal」。

examples.en: Her proposal explains how the shop can cut waiting time.
examples.tc: 她的建議書說明店舖如何縮短等候時間。

examples.en: Send the proposal to the supplier before the deadline.
examples.tc: 截止日期前把建議書寄給供應商。

examples.en: We discussed the proposal in the WhatsApp group.
examples.tc: 我們在 WhatsApp 群組討論了該建議書。

synonyms.difference: A plan can stay internal. A proposal is offered to someone else.

senses.glossEn: Comments on how well something worked, used to improve it.
senses.glossTc: 關於效果好壞的意見，用來改進。

examples.en: Customer feedback said the queue felt too long.
examples.tc: 顧客意見指排隊時間令人覺得太長。

examples.en: I will give feedback once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「give feedback」。

examples.en: Ask for feedback after the till training.
examples.tc: 收銀培訓後請收集意見。

examples.en: The WhatsApp feedback helped us change the process.
examples.tc: WhatsApp 上的意見幫助我們改了流程。

examples.en: The team asked how feedback works here: 關於效果好壞的意見，用來改進。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「feedback」怎麼用：關於效果好壞的意見，用來改進。

synonyms.difference: Comments can be any remarks. Feedback is given so work can improve.

senses.glossEn: Money paid back to a customer.
senses.glossTc: 退回給顧客的金錢。

examples.en: Can you issue a refund for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「issue a refund」嗎？

examples.en: I will ask for a refund once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「ask for a refund」。

examples.en: We issued a refund after the item arrived damaged.
examples.tc: 貨品送達時已損壞，我們已辦理退款。

examples.en: The till needs a manager code for a refund.
examples.tc: 收銀機辦理退款需要經理密碼。

examples.en: She asked for a refund by WhatsApp the same night.
examples.tc: 她當晚用 WhatsApp 要求退款。

synonyms.difference: Reimbursement often pays back a cost someone already spent. A refund returns a purchase price.

senses.glossEn: A line of people waiting for their turn.
senses.glossTc: 輪候的一排人。

examples.en: We should join the queue after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「join the queue」。

examples.en: Write a long queue on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「a long queue」寫在白板上。

examples.en: The lunch queue reached the door by twelve.
examples.tc: 中午十二時，午膳排隊已排到門口。

examples.en: Open a second till if the queue is past the shelves.
examples.tc: 若排隊超過貨架，就開第二部收銀機。

examples.en: There was a queue at the MTR ticket machine.
examples.tc: 港鐵售票機前有人排隊。

synonyms.difference: Line is more common in American English. Queue is the usual British and Hong Kong word.

senses.glossEn: How something feels to a person while they use a shop or service.
senses.glossTc: 顧客使用店舖或服務時的感受。

examples.en: A slow queue can spoil an otherwise good shopping experience.
examples.tc: 排隊太慢，即使其他環節不錯，購物體驗也會變差。

examples.en: The briefing covered customer experience.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「customer experience」。

examples.en: Experience is the teacher of all things. — Julius Caesar
examples.tc: 凱撒：「經驗是萬事的老師。」

examples.en: We want a calm experience at the till on Saturdays.
examples.tc: 我們希望星期六收銀處的體驗保持冷靜有序。

examples.en: The WhatsApp order experience should feel simple.
examples.tc: WhatsApp 訂貨體驗應讓人覺得簡單。

synonyms.difference: An impression is a first judgment. Experience covers the whole visit.

senses.glossEn: A statement that something is wrong or not good enough.
senses.glossTc: 指某事有問題或未達標準的陳述。

examples.en: We should make a complaint after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「make a complaint」。

examples.en: I will handle a complaint once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「handle a complaint」。

examples.en: We logged the complaint and offered a replacement the same day.
examples.tc: 我們已記錄投訴，並在當日提供更換。

examples.en: The complaint about the till wait came by WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 有關收銀等候的投訴是經 WhatsApp 傳來的。

examples.en: Handle the complaint before the next customer reaches the counter.
examples.tc: 下一位顧客到櫃位前，先處理好這宗投訴。

synonyms.difference: An objection is often raised in a meeting. A complaint is usually about service or a product.

senses.glossEn: To start selling or offering something new in public.
senses.glossTc: 公開推出新產品或新服務。

examples.en: Can you launch a product for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「launch a product」嗎？

examples.en: Can you launch date for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「launch date」嗎？

examples.en: We will launch the new loyalty card in October.
examples.tc: 我們將於十月推出新的會員卡。

examples.en: Do not launch the app until the till can take the code.
examples.tc: 收銀機能讀取代碼前，不要推出應用程式。

examples.en: They launched a weekend stall near the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 他們在港鐵出口附近推出週末檔攤。

synonyms.difference: Release is common for software. Launch often includes the public start.

senses.glossEn: To change the main direction of a business when the first plan is not working.
senses.glossTc: 原計劃行不通時，改變生意的主要方向。

examples.en: If shop traffic stays low, we may pivot to WhatsApp orders.
examples.tc: 若店舖人流持續偏低，我們或會轉向 WhatsApp 訂貨。

examples.en: We should pivot the business after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「pivot the business」。

examples.en: They pivoted from a food stall to weekend catering.
examples.tc: 他們由小吃攤轉向週末到會。

examples.en: The team pivoted after the supplier raised prices.
examples.tc: 供應商加價後，團隊改變了方向。

examples.en: Do not forget to pivot before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「pivot」。

synonyms.difference: Change course is ordinary English. Pivot is business slang for a planned turn.

senses.glossEn: The money moving in and out of a business over a period.
senses.glossTc: 一段時間內流入和流出生意的現金。

examples.en: A customer asked about positive cash flow.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「positive cash flow」。

examples.en: Write cash flow problem on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「cash flow problem」寫在白板上。

examples.en: Slow cash flow made it hard to pay the supplier early.
examples.tc: 現金流偏慢，難以提早支付供應商。

examples.en: Weekend cash flow looks healthier after the till change.
examples.tc: 改了收銀安排後，週末現金流看來較穩。

examples.en: Track cash flow before you approve the extra stock.
examples.tc: 審批額外存貨前，先追蹤現金流。

synonyms.difference: Liquidity is a finance term for how easily assets become cash. Cash flow is the actual movement of money.

senses.glossEn: To make a machine or program do work that people used to do by hand.
senses.glossTc: 改由機器或程式完成以往人手做的工作。

examples.en: We should automate the process after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「automate the process」。

examples.en: Please automate invoices before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「automate invoices」。

examples.en: Do not automate a messy process; clean it first.
examples.tc: 不要先把混亂流程自動化；應先理順。

examples.en: We will automate stock alerts after the till upgrade.
examples.tc: 收銀系統升級後，我們會把存貨提示自動化。

examples.en: Can we automate the WhatsApp order confirmation?
examples.tc: 我們可以把 WhatsApp 訂單確認自動化嗎？

synonyms.difference: Computerise means put work on a computer. Automate means the computer then does the steps.

senses.glossEn: To put a system or update into real use.
senses.glossTc: 把系統或更新正式投入使用。

examples.en: Can you deploy an update for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「deploy an update」嗎？

examples.en: We should deploy to production after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「deploy to production」。

examples.en: We will deploy the till update after closing time.
examples.tc: 我們會在關門後部署收銀系統更新。

examples.en: Do not deploy during the Saturday queue.
examples.tc: 星期六排隊高峰期間不要部署。

examples.en: IT will deploy the backup tool this week.
examples.tc: 資訊科技部本週會部署備份工具。

synonyms.difference: Roll out often means introduce to users in stages. Deploy is the technical put-live step.

senses.glossEn: A copy of files kept so work can be restored if the original is lost.
senses.glossTc: 另存的檔案副本，以便原本遺失時還原。

examples.en: We should make a backup after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「make a backup」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention restore from backup.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「restore from backup」。

examples.en: Keep a backup of your study file outside this phone.
examples.tc: 請在這部手機以外另存學習檔備份。

examples.en: The till backup runs after midnight.
examples.tc: 收銀機備份在午夜後執行。

examples.en: Send the meeting notes backup to WhatsApp files.
examples.tc: 把會議紀錄備份傳到 WhatsApp 檔案。

synonyms.difference: Any copy is a copy. A backup exists specifically for recovery.

senses.glossEn: Not connected to the internet, but still able to use saved material.
senses.glossTc: 未連接互聯網，但仍可使用已儲存的資料。

examples.en: Today's notes mention work offline.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「work offline」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention offline mode.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「offline mode」。

examples.en: The installed pack works offline after you prepare it.
examples.tc: 完成準備後，已安裝的內容可離線使用。

examples.en: The till can take cash offline if the line drops.
examples.tc: 若網絡中斷，收銀機仍可離線收現金。

examples.en: Save the file for offline reading on the MTR.
examples.tc: 把檔案儲存，以便在港鐵離線閱讀。

senses.glossEn: To arrange for something to happen at a particular time.
senses.glossTc: 安排某事在指定時間發生。

examples.en: We should schedule a meeting after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「schedule a meeting」。

examples.en: Please schedule a review before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「schedule a review」。

examples.en: Let's schedule the staff briefing for Monday morning.
examples.tc: 我們把員工簡介安排在星期一上午。

examples.en: Schedule the courier after the till closes.
examples.tc: 安排速遞在收銀機關機後來取件。

examples.en: Can we schedule a supplier call around the MTR ride?
examples.tc: 我們可否把供應商通話安排在乘港鐵前後？

synonyms.difference: Arrange is broader. Schedule always sets a time.

senses.glossEn: To say that something is true or definitely arranged.
senses.glossTc: 表明某事屬實，或已確定安排。

examples.en: Please confirm that the Saturday shift is covered.
examples.tc: 請確認星期六的更期已有人頂。

examples.en: I will confirm the time once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「confirm the time」。

examples.en: Confirm the order on WhatsApp before we pack it.
examples.tc: 包裝前請先用 WhatsApp 確認訂單。

examples.en: The customer confirmed pickup at the till.
examples.tc: 顧客確認在收銀處取貨。

examples.en: Do not forget to confirm before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「confirm」。

synonyms.difference: Verify checks evidence. Confirm can also mean give a definite yes.

senses.glossEn: To discuss terms until both sides can accept an agreement.
senses.glossTc: 雙方商討條件，直至可以接受協議。

examples.en: We should negotiate a price after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「negotiate a price」。

examples.en: Can you negotiate terms for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「negotiate terms」嗎？

examples.en: We negotiated a longer payment period with the supplier.
examples.tc: 我們與供應商談妥較長的付款期。

examples.en: She will negotiate the stall rent after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後她會商討檔位租金。

examples.en: Do not negotiate a discount at the till without approval.
examples.tc: 未獲審批，不要在收銀處商討折扣。

synonyms.difference: Bargain often means argue over price. Negotiate can cover time, scope, or terms.

senses.glossEn: To contact someone again about a matter that is not finished.
senses.glossTc: 就尚未完成的事情再次聯絡對方。

examples.en: I will follow up with the supplier if we have no reply by noon.
examples.tc: 若中午前仍未回覆，我會再跟供應商跟進。

examples.en: I will follow up by email once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「follow up by email」。

examples.en: Please follow up the refund after the till report prints.
examples.tc: 收銀報告列印後，請跟進退款。

examples.en: Follow up on WhatsApp, not only by email.
examples.tc: 請用 WhatsApp 跟進，不要只發電郵。

examples.en: We can follow up this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「follow up」。

synonyms.difference: Chase is informal and can sound impatient. Follow up is the usual workplace wording.

senses.glossEn: A polite word used when asking for something.
senses.glossTc: 提出要求時表示禮貌的用語。

examples.en: Please wait here while I check the stockroom.
examples.tc: 請在這裏稍候，我去貨倉查看。

examples.en: Write yes, please on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「yes, please」寫在白板上。

examples.en: Please send the invoice before the deadline.
examples.tc: 請在截止日期前把發票寄出。

examples.en: Two bags, please.
examples.tc: 請給兩個袋子。

examples.en: The team asked how please works here: 提出要求時表示禮貌的用語。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「please」怎麼用：提出要求時表示禮貌的用語。

senses.glossEn: To tell someone you are grateful.
senses.glossTc: 向對方表示感謝。

examples.en: I want to thank the team for covering the till.
examples.tc: 我想多謝同事頂了收銀。

examples.en: Thank you for the WhatsApp update on the train.
examples.tc: 謝謝你在車上用 WhatsApp 更新情況。

examples.en: Thank the customer before you hand over the bag.
examples.tc: 把袋子交給顧客前，先向對方道謝。

examples.en: We can thank this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「thank」。

examples.en: Ask a colleague if thank is needed today.
examples.tc: 問同事今天是否需要「thank」。

senses.glossEn: To make it easier for someone to do something.
senses.glossTc: 協助別人，使事情較容易完成。

examples.en: I can help you find a smaller size.
examples.tc: 我可以幫你找細一碼。

examples.en: Please help with this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「help with」。

examples.en: God helps those who help themselves. — Benjamin Franklin
examples.tc: 富蘭克林：「天助自助者。」

examples.en: Can you help me pack before the queue grows?
examples.tc: 排隊變長前，你能幫我裝袋嗎？

examples.en: This note will help the new staff close the till.
examples.tc: 這張便條能幫助新同事關收銀機。

synonyms.difference: Assist is more formal. Help is the ordinary word.

senses.glossEn: Used to apologise or to show you regret a problem.
senses.glossTc: 用來道歉，或表示對問題感到抱歉。

examples.en: Sorry for the wait; the next till is opening now.
examples.tc: 抱歉讓你等候；下一個收銀櫃位現正開放。

examples.en: I am sorry the supplier missed today's deadline.
examples.tc: 供應商趕不及今天的截止日期，我很抱歉。

examples.en: Sorry, this carriage is too crowded to talk.
examples.tc: 抱歉，這卡太擠，不方便談話。

examples.en: Today is especially sorry on the shop floor.
examples.tc: 店舖今天特別「sorry」。

examples.en: Keep the wording sorry in the shop notice.
examples.tc: 店舖告示的用字要保持「sorry」。

senses.glossEn: To give money so you can have something.
senses.glossTc: 付款以換取某物。

examples.en: Did you buy lunch near the MTR?
examples.tc: 你有沒有在港鐵站附近買午餐？

examples.en: The shop will buy stock from a new supplier.
examples.tc: 店舖會向新供應商入貨。

examples.en: We should buy from this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「buy from」。

examples.en: I need to buy more paper bags before Saturday.
examples.tc: 週末前我要再買多些紙袋。

examples.en: We can buy this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「buy」。

synonyms.difference: Purchase is more formal and common on invoices.

senses.glossEn: To give something to someone in return for money.
senses.glossTc: 把東西交給對方以換取金錢。

examples.en: Can you sell to this for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「sell to」嗎？

examples.en: We should sell out after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「sell out」。

examples.en: A customer asked about hard to sell.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「hard to sell」。

examples.en: We sell phone cases next to the till.
examples.tc: 我們在收銀處旁邊賣手機套。

examples.en: Do you still sell the weekend lunch set?
examples.tc: 你們還有賣週末午餐套餐嗎？

synonyms.difference: Offer can mean make available. Sell means money changes hands.

senses.glossEn: To give money for goods, work, or a bill.
senses.glossTc: 為貨品、工作或帳單付出金錢。

examples.en: You can pay by Octopus or FPS at this till.
examples.tc: 這個收銀處可用八達通或轉數快付款。

examples.en: We should pay the bill after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「pay the bill」。

examples.en: I will pay later once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「pay later」。

examples.en: I will pay the supplier on Friday.
examples.tc: 我星期五會付款給供應商。

examples.en: Please pay before you leave the shop.
examples.tc: 離開店舖前請先付款。

synonyms.difference: Settle often means pay a remaining amount to close an account.

senses.glossEn: To stay until something happens or someone is ready.
senses.glossTc: 留在某處，直至事情發生或對方準備好。

examples.en: Please wait here while I check the stockroom.
examples.tc: 請在這裏稍候，我去貨倉查看。

examples.en: Can you wait for this for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「wait for」嗎？

examples.en: Can you wait a moment for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「wait a moment」嗎？

examples.en: They also serve who only stand and wait. — John Milton
examples.tc: 彌爾頓：「只是站著等候的人，同樣在服務。」

examples.en: Customers wait at the till if the queue is long.
examples.tc: 排隊長時，顧客會在收銀處等候。

senses.glossEn: To make something not shut, or to start business for the day.
senses.glossTc: 打開某物，或開始當日營業。

examples.en: We open the shop at ten on weekdays.
examples.tc: 平日我們十時開店。

examples.en: Please open at this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「open at」。

examples.en: Please open a file before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「open a file」。

examples.en: Can you open the till for the next customer?
examples.tc: 你可以為下一位顧客開收銀機嗎？

examples.en: Open the WhatsApp chat and send the address.
examples.tc: 打開 WhatsApp 對話，把地址寄出。

senses.glossEn: To say a question or request so you can get information or help.
senses.glossTc: 提出問題或要求，以取得資料或協助。

examples.en: Can you ask for this for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「ask for」嗎？

examples.en: Can you ask about this for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「ask about」嗎？

examples.en: Please ask politely before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「ask politely」。

examples.en: Ask, and it shall be given you. — Matthew 7:7
examples.tc: 聖經馬太福音：「你們祈求，就給你們。」

examples.en: Ask the customer if they need a bag.
examples.tc: 問問顧客是否需要袋子。

synonyms.difference: Enquire is more formal, often used in written business English.

senses.glossEn: To give information to someone in words.
senses.glossTc: 用說話把資料告訴對方。

examples.en: Please tell me the deadline in one sentence.
examples.tc: 請用一句話告訴我截止日期。

examples.en: Can you tell the team for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「tell the team」嗎？

examples.en: Please tell the truth before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「tell the truth」。

examples.en: Tell the next customer the till is free.
examples.tc: 告訴下一位顧客收銀處已經得閒。

examples.en: She told the team on WhatsApp that the MTR was delayed.
examples.tc: 她在 WhatsApp 告訴同事港鐵誤點。

synonyms.difference: Inform is more formal and often written.

senses.glossEn: To phone someone, or to shout to get their attention.
senses.glossTc: 致電給某人，或大聲叫以引起注意。

examples.en: I will call the supplier if WhatsApp stays quiet.
examples.tc: 若 WhatsApp 一直沒回覆，我會致電供應商。

examples.en: Please call back before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「call back」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention a quick call.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「a quick call」。

examples.en: Call me when you reach the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 你到港鐵出口時致電給我。

examples.en: Please call the next number at the till.
examples.tc: 請在收銀處叫下一個號碼。

synonyms.difference: Phone always means use the telephone. Call can also mean shout a name.

senses.glossEn: To cause a message, file, or parcel to go to someone.
senses.glossTc: 把訊息、檔案或包裹送到對方。

examples.en: Please send the file before you get on the MTR.
examples.tc: 上港鐵前請把檔案寄出。

examples.en: Please send to this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「send to」。

examples.en: I will send a message once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「send a message」。

examples.en: Send the invoice after you close the till.
examples.tc: 關收銀機後把發票寄出。

examples.en: I sent a WhatsApp photo of the damaged box.
examples.tc: 我用 WhatsApp 傳了損壞箱子的相片。

senses.glossEn: To get something that is given or sent to you.
senses.glossTc: 收到別人給予或寄出的東西。

examples.en: We should receive an email after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「receive an email」。

examples.en: Please receive a parcel before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「receive a parcel」。

examples.en: Can you receive payment for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「receive payment」嗎？

examples.en: Did you receive the supplier's WhatsApp?
examples.tc: 你收到供應商的 WhatsApp 嗎？

examples.en: We receive parcels at the back door, not the till.
examples.tc: 我們在後門收包裹，不在收銀處收。

synonyms.difference: Get is the everyday word. Receive is more formal.

senses.glossEn: To reach a place.
senses.glossTc: 到達某地。

examples.en: I will message you when I arrive at the MTR.
examples.tc: 我到港鐵時會發訊息給你。

examples.en: Can you arrive on time for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「arrive on time」嗎？

examples.en: We should arrive late after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「arrive late」。

examples.en: The stock should arrive before we open.
examples.tc: 存貨應在我們開店前送到。

examples.en: A customer arrived while the till was still closed.
examples.tc: 收銀機還未開，已有顧客到達。

synonyms.difference: Reach stresses getting as far as a place. Arrive is the moment you get there.

senses.glossEn: To go away from a place.
senses.glossTc: 離開某地。

examples.en: I leave home early to miss the MTR crush.
examples.tc: 我提早出門，避開港鐵擠迫。

examples.en: Do not leave the shop until the alarm is set.
examples.tc: 未設定警報前不要離開店舖。

examples.en: I will leave early once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「leave early」。

examples.en: Please leave the keys beside the till.
examples.tc: 請把鎖匙放在收銀處旁邊才離開。

examples.en: Do not forget to leave before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「leave」。

senses.glossEn: To move on foot.
senses.glossTc: 步行移動。

examples.en: Walk to the warehouse; it is close to the station.
examples.tc: 步行去貨倉吧，那裏鄰近車站。

examples.en: I walk from the MTR even when it rains.
examples.tc: 即使下雨，我也由港鐵步行。

examples.en: Today's notes mention a short walk.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「a short walk」。

examples.en: We walked the customer to the till.
examples.tc: 我們陪顧客走到收銀處。

examples.en: Do not forget to walk before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「walk」。

senses.glossEn: To move something into your hands or to use a route or vehicle.
senses.glossTc: 把東西拿到手上，或乘搭某交通工具。

examples.en: Take a ticket and wait for your number.
examples.tc: 取籌，然後等候你的號碼。

examples.en: I take the MTR to the supplier on Tuesdays.
examples.tc: 星期二我乘港鐵去見供應商。

examples.en: Please take this bag to the till.
examples.tc: 請把這個袋子拿到收銀處。

examples.en: We can take this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「take」。

examples.en: Do not forget to take before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「take」。

senses.glossEn: To hand something to someone.
senses.glossTc: 把東西交給對方。

examples.en: Give me five minutes to check WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 給我五分鐘查看 WhatsApp。

examples.en: We should give to this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「give to」。

examples.en: I will give back once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「give back」。

examples.en: It is more blessed to give than to receive. — Acts 20:35
examples.tc: 聖經使徒行傳：「施比受更為有福。」

examples.en: Give the receipt to the customer.
examples.tc: 把收據交給顧客。

synonyms.difference: Hand often means pass with your hands. Give is broader.

senses.glossEn: To obtain, receive, or become.
senses.glossTc: 取得、收到，或變成某種狀態。

examples.en: Can you get a spare roll for the till?
examples.tc: 你能取一卷備用收銀紙嗎？

examples.en: I get off at Mong Kok and walk to the shop.
examples.tc: 我在旺角下車，再步行到店。

examples.en: We need to get approval before Friday.
examples.tc: 我們要在星期五前取得審批。

examples.en: We can get this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「get」。

examples.en: Do not forget to get before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「get」。

senses.glossEn: To discover something after looking or by chance.
senses.glossTc: 經尋找或偶然發現某事物。

examples.en: I cannot find the spare till key.
examples.tc: 我找不到備用收銀鎖匙。

examples.en: Did you find a seat on the MTR?
examples.tc: 你在港鐵找到座位嗎？

examples.en: Please find out before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「find out」。

examples.en: We found the missing invoice in WhatsApp files.
examples.tc: 我們在 WhatsApp 檔案找到那張遺失的發票。

examples.en: We can find this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「find」。

synonyms.difference: Locate is more formal and often used for a place or file.

senses.glossEn: To require something because it is necessary.
senses.glossTc: 因為有必要而需要某事物。

examples.en: We need more coins in the till.
examples.tc: 收銀機需要多些硬幣。

examples.en: I need to leave before the last MTR.
examples.tc: 我要在尾班港鐵前離開。

examples.en: The briefing covered if you need.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「if you need」。

examples.en: Do you need a bag for this?
examples.tc: 這個需要袋子嗎？

examples.en: Do not forget to need before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「need」。

senses.glossEn: To wish to have or do something.
senses.glossTc: 想得到或想做某事。

examples.en: I want to finish this before the meeting.
examples.tc: 我想在會議前做完這件事。

examples.en: The briefing covered if you want.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「if you want」。

examples.en: I will want a once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「want a」。

examples.en: The customer wants a smaller size.
examples.tc: 顧客想要細一碼。

examples.en: Do you want the receipt in WhatsApp?
examples.tc: 你想把收據傳到 WhatsApp 嗎？

senses.glossEn: To have information in your mind.
senses.glossTc: 心中已有某項資料或認知。

examples.en: Do you know the supplier's pickup time?
examples.tc: 你知道供應商的取貨時間嗎？

examples.en: I know the till code; I will open it.
examples.tc: 我知道收銀密碼，我來開。

examples.en: Let me know when you reach the MTR.
examples.tc: 你到港鐵時告訴我。

examples.en: To know that you know nothing is the beginning of wisdom. — Socrates
examples.tc: 蘇格拉底：「知道自己一無所知，是智慧的開始。」

examples.en: Do not forget to know before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「know」。

senses.glossEn: To use your mind to consider an idea or opinion.
senses.glossTc: 用頭腦考慮想法或意見。

examples.en: I think we should open a second till.
examples.tc: 我認為應開第二部收銀機。

examples.en: Think about the deadline before you promise.
examples.tc: 答應之前先想想截止日期。

examples.en: We should think before this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「think before」。

examples.en: I think, therefore I am. — René Descartes
examples.tc: 笛卡兒：「我思故我在。」

examples.en: She thought the WhatsApp was from a customer.
examples.tc: 她以為那則 WhatsApp 是顧客發的。

senses.glossEn: To keep a fact in your mind, or bring it back.
senses.glossTc: 把事情記在腦中，或重新想起。

examples.en: Remember to lock the till drawer.
examples.tc: 記得鎖好收銀錢箱。

examples.en: I cannot remember the supplier's stall number.
examples.tc: 我想不起供應商的檔位號碼。

examples.en: I will remember that once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「remember that」。

examples.en: Remember the meeting is after the MTR peak.
examples.tc: 記得會議在港鐵高峰過後。

examples.en: Do not forget to remember before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「remember」。

synonyms.difference: Recall is more formal and often means bring a memory back.

senses.glossEn: To fail to remember.
senses.glossTc: 未能記起。

examples.en: Do not forget the till report tonight.
examples.tc: 今晚不要忘記收銀報告。

examples.en: I forgot my Octopus at home.
examples.tc: 我把八達通留在家裏。

examples.en: Please forget to this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「forget to」。

examples.en: She forgot to confirm on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 她忘了在 WhatsApp 確認。

examples.en: We can forget this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「forget」。

senses.glossEn: To take something with you to a place.
senses.glossTc: 把東西帶到某地。

examples.en: Please bring to this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「bring to」。

examples.en: We should bring with you after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「bring with you」。

examples.en: We should bring back after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「bring back」。

examples.en: Please bring the spare bags to the till.
examples.tc: 請把備用袋子帶到收銀處。

examples.en: I will bring lunch from the MTR exit stall.
examples.tc: 我會在港鐵出口檔攤帶午餐回來。

senses.glossEn: To hold something and move with it.
senses.glossTc: 拿着東西並移動。

examples.en: Please carry to this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「carry to」。

examples.en: Can you carry a bag for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「carry a bag」嗎？

examples.en: The briefing covered too heavy to carry.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「too heavy to carry」。

examples.en: Can you carry this box to the stockroom?
examples.tc: 你能把這個箱子拿到貨倉嗎？

examples.en: I carry a spare till roll in my bag.
examples.tc: 我袋裏帶着備用收銀紙。

senses.glossEn: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
senses.glossTc: 把食物放入口中吞下。

examples.en: We eat lunch after the morning queue dies down.
examples.tc: 上午排隊散去後我們才吃午餐。

examples.en: Please eat before this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「eat before」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention something to eat.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「something to eat」。

examples.en: I ate a boxed rice near the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵附近吃了盒飯。

examples.en: Please do not eat behind the till.
examples.tc: 請不要在收銀處後面進食。

senses.glossEn: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
senses.glossTc: 把液體送入口中吞下。

examples.en: Please drink water before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「drink water」。

examples.en: The briefing covered have a drink.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「have a drink」。

examples.en: Can you drink tea for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「drink tea」嗎？

examples.en: Drink some water before the long meeting.
examples.tc: 開長會前先喝點水。

examples.en: I drank tea on the MTR platform.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵月台喝茶。

senses.glossEn: To rest with your body on a seat.
senses.glossTc: 坐在座位上。

examples.en: We should sit down after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「sit down」。

examples.en: I will sit here once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「sit here」。

examples.en: Please sit on this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「sit on」。

examples.en: Please sit while I check the size in the stockroom.
examples.tc: 請先坐下，我去貨倉查尺碼。

examples.en: I sat on the MTR and answered WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 我坐在港鐵上回 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: To be on your feet, not sitting.
senses.glossTc: 站着，不是坐着。

examples.en: We should stand in line after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「stand in line」。

examples.en: Please stand by this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「stand by」。

examples.en: Can you stand up for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「stand up」嗎？

examples.en: Please stand behind the yellow line at the till.
examples.tc: 請在收銀處黃線後站着。

examples.en: I stood on the MTR all the way to Central.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上一直站到中環。

senses.glossEn: To turn your eyes toward something.
senses.glossTc: 把視線轉向某物。

examples.en: Look at the till screen before you tap Octopus.
examples.tc: 拍八達通前先看收銀機螢幕。

examples.en: We should look for this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「look for」。

examples.en: We should look after this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「look after」。

examples.en: I looked for the supplier at the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵出口找供應商。

examples.en: Please look at this WhatsApp photo of the damage.
examples.tc: 請看這張 WhatsApp 損壞相片。

senses.glossEn: To pay attention to sounds or spoken words.
senses.glossTc: 留心聽聲音或說話。

examples.en: Listen to the customer before you offer a refund.
examples.tc: 提出退款前，先聽顧客說。

examples.en: Please listen for the till beep.
examples.tc: 請留意收銀機的提示聲。

examples.en: Please listen carefully before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「listen carefully」。

examples.en: I listen to the meeting notes on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上聽會議錄音。

examples.en: We can listen this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「listen」。

senses.glossEn: To say words; to talk.
senses.glossTc: 說出話語；交談。

examples.en: Can you speak to the supplier this afternoon?
examples.tc: 你今天下午能跟供應商談嗎？

examples.en: Please speak slowly; the till area is noisy.
examples.tc: 請說慢一點，收銀處很嘈。

examples.en: I will speak English with the tourist at the counter.
examples.tc: 我會用英語跟櫃位的旅客說話。

examples.en: We can speak this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「speak」。

examples.en: Do not forget to speak before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「speak」。

synonyms.difference: Talk is more informal. Speak is common with languages and formal contact.

senses.glossEn: To put words on paper or in a message.
senses.glossTc: 把文字寫在紙上或訊息裏。

examples.en: We should write down after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「write down」。

examples.en: We should write a note after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「write a note」。

examples.en: We should write to this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「write to」。

examples.en: Either write something worth reading, or do something worth writing. — Benjamin Franklin
examples.tc: 富蘭克林：「要麼寫值得讀的東西，要麼做值得寫的事。」

examples.en: Write the pickup name on the bag.
examples.tc: 把取貨姓名寫在袋子上。

senses.glossEn: To make an effort to do something.
senses.glossTc: 嘗試做某事。

examples.en: I will try to reach the shop before the MTR peak.
examples.tc: 我會盡量在港鐵高峰前到店。

examples.en: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again. — Thomas H. Palmer
examples.tc: 帕爾默：「一次不成功，就再試、再試。」

examples.en: I will try on this once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「try on」。

examples.en: Try the other till if this one is frozen.
examples.tc: 若這部收銀機當機，試試另一部。

examples.en: Please try a smaller size in the fitting room.
examples.tc: 請到試身室試細一碼。

senses.glossEn: To do a job with a tool, system, or method.
senses.glossTc: 用工具、系統或方法來做事。

examples.en: Use the handheld scanner at the till.
examples.tc: 在收銀處使用手提掃描器。

examples.en: Please use for this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「use for」。

examples.en: A customer asked about how to use.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「how to use」。

examples.en: I use WhatsApp for supplier updates.
examples.tc: 我用 WhatsApp 接收供應商最新情況。

examples.en: You can use Octopus on this gate.
examples.tc: 這個閘機可用八達通。

senses.glossEn: To continue to have something, or to make it stay in a state.
senses.glossTc: 繼續持有，或使某物保持某狀態。

examples.en: Keep the spare change in the till drawer.
examples.tc: 把備用零錢放在收銀錢箱。

examples.en: I will keep in this once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「keep in」。

examples.en: We should keep for this after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「keep for」。

examples.en: Keep thy shop, and thy shop will keep thee. — English proverb
examples.tc: 英語諺語：「好好打理你的店，店也會養活你。」

examples.en: Keep this WhatsApp thread for the complaint.
examples.tc: 保留這則 WhatsApp 對話作投訴紀錄。

senses.glossEn: To move something to a place.
senses.glossTc: 把東西放到某處。

examples.en: Can you put in this for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「put in」嗎？

examples.en: Please put on this before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「put on」。

examples.en: Please put back before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「put back」。

examples.en: We can put this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「put」。

examples.en: Do not forget to put before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「put」。

senses.glossEn: To let someone see something.
senses.glossTc: 讓對方看見某物。

examples.en: Show the customer the size chart.
examples.tc: 把尺碼表給顧客看。

examples.en: I will show you the till steps after lunch.
examples.tc: 午飯後我會示範收銀步驟。

examples.en: Show me the WhatsApp from the supplier.
examples.tc: 把供應商的 WhatsApp 給我看。

examples.en: We can show this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「show」。

examples.en: Do not forget to show before you leave.
examples.tc: 離開前不要忘記「show」。

senses.glossEn: To let other people have or see the same thing.
senses.glossTc: 讓別人一同擁有或看見。

examples.en: Can we share a taxi from the MTR?
examples.tc: 我們可以由港鐵共乘的士嗎？

examples.en: I will share with this once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「share with」。

examples.en: Please share the file before we close.
examples.tc: 關門前請先「share the file」。

examples.en: Share the meeting notes in the group.
examples.tc: 把會議紀錄分享到群組。

examples.en: I shared the till password with the duty manager only.

examples.tc: 防火牆紀錄顯示一次奇怪登入嘗試。

examples.en: The team asked how firewall works here: 阻擋不受歡迎網絡流量的軟件或盒子。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「firewall」怎麼用：阻擋不受歡迎網絡流量的軟件或盒子。

senses.glossEn: A private tunnel that sends internet traffic more safely.
senses.glossTc: 較安全地傳送互聯網流量的私人隧道。

examples.en: Use the VPN on public MTR Wi-Fi.
examples.tc: 在港鐵公眾無線網絡使用虛擬私人網絡。

examples.en: A customer asked about a VPN.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「a VPN」。

examples.en: The briefing covered connect to VPN.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「connect to VPN」。

examples.en: The VPN stopped me reaching the till admin page.
examples.tc: 虛擬私人網絡令我到不了收銀管理頁。

examples.en: Staff must not share the VPN password.
examples.tc: 同事不可分享虛擬私人網絡密碼。

senses.glossEn: Fake messages that try to steal passwords or money.
senses.glossTc: 試圖盜取密碼或金錢的假訊息。

examples.en: Write a phishing email on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「a phishing email」寫在白板上。

examples.en: Today's notes mention phishing link.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「phishing link」。

examples.en: Today's notes mention phishing attempt.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「phishing attempt」。

examples.en: That email is phishing; do not tap the link.
examples.tc: 那封電郵是釣魚，不要輕觸連結。

examples.en: Phishing can look like a supplier WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 釣魚可以看起來像供應商 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: Unwanted bulk messages.
senses.glossTc: 不想要的大量訊息。

examples.en: The shop inbox is full of spam.
examples.tc: 店舖收件箱充滿垃圾郵件。

examples.en: A customer asked about spam email.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「spam email」。

examples.en: A customer asked about spam folder.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「spam folder」。

examples.en: Do not give the till email to spam forms.
examples.tc: 不要把收銀電郵填進垃圾表格。

examples.en: Spam hid the real supplier invoice.
examples.tc: 垃圾郵件把真正供應商發票擋住了。

senses.glossEn: A dishonest trick to take money or data.
senses.glossTc: 騙取金錢或資料的不誠實把戲。

examples.en: A scam caller asked for the till password.
examples.tc: 詐騙來電要收銀密碼。

examples.en: A customer asked about scam warning.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「scam warning」。

examples.en: If a deal is only on WhatsApp with urgency, it may be a scam.
examples.tc: 若交易只在 WhatsApp 而且催得很急，可能是詐騙。

examples.en: Put scam on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「scam」寫進下午清單。

examples.en: Ask a colleague if scam is needed today.
examples.tc: 問同事今天是否需要「scam」。

senses.glossEn: A one-time password sent to prove it is you.
senses.glossTc: 用來證明是你本人的一次性密碼。

examples.en: The OTP is in SMS; read it to me.
examples.tc: 一次性密碼在短訊，讀給我聽。

examples.en: The briefing covered OTP code.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「OTP code」。

examples.en: A customer asked about enter the OTP.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「enter the OTP」。

examples.en: OTP failed in the basement; step outside.
examples.tc: 地庫一次性密碼失敗，請到外面。

examples.en: Never send an OTP to a caller.
examples.tc: 千萬不要把一次性密碼給來電者。

senses.glossEn: A number sent to confirm a login or payment.
senses.glossTc: 用來確認登入或付款的數字。

examples.en: Enter the verification code from the SMS.
examples.tc: 輸入短訊裏的驗證碼。

examples.en: The verification code expired; request a new one.
examples.tc: 驗證碼過期，請再要一個。

examples.en: Do not share the verification code on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 不要在 WhatsApp 分享驗證碼。

examples.en: Put verification code on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「verification code」寫進下午清單。

examples.en: Ask a colleague if verification code is needed today.
examples.tc: 問同事今天是否需要「verification code」。

senses.glossEn: A short check that shows you are a person, not a robot.
senses.glossTc: 顯示你是人不是機械人的短檢查。

examples.en: The captcha on the roster site is tiny.
examples.tc: 更表網站的驗證碼很小。

examples.en: I failed the captcha twice on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上驗證碼失敗兩次。

examples.en: A captcha delay is better than a bot filling orders.
examples.tc: 驗證碼延誤好過機械人填訂單。

examples.en: The team asked how captcha works here: 顯示你是人不是機械人的短檢查。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「captcha」怎麼用：顯示你是人不是機械人的短檢查。

examples.en: Put captcha on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「captcha」寫進下午清單。

senses.glossEn: Control over who can see personal information.
senses.glossTc: 控制誰能看見個人資料。

examples.en: Check privacy settings on the shop tablet.
examples.tc: 查看店舖平板電腦的私隱設定。

examples.en: A privacy complaint came by WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 有私隱投訴經 WhatsApp 傳來。

examples.en: Today's notes mention privacy of this.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「privacy of」。

examples.en: Privacy means we do not shout card numbers.
examples.tc: 私隱代表我們不大聲讀卡號。

examples.en: The team asked how privacy works here: 控制誰能看見個人資料。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「privacy」怎麼用：控制誰能看見個人資料。

senses.glossEn: Information that can identify a person, such as a name or phone.
senses.glossTc: 可識別一個人的資料，例如姓名或電話。

examples.en: Do not leave personal data on the till screen.
examples.tc: 不要把個人資料留在收銀螢幕。

examples.en: A customer asked about personal data of this.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「personal data of」。

examples.en: We should handle personal data after the briefing.
examples.tc: 簡報後我們應該「handle personal data」。

examples.en: Personal data goes in the locked folder.
examples.tc: 個人資料放在上鎖資料夾。

examples.en: Delete personal data when the pickup is done.
examples.tc: 取貨完成後刪除個人資料。

senses.glossEn: Hong Kong's Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance, the local privacy law.
senses.glossTc: 香港《個人資料（私隱）條例》，即本地私隱法律。

examples.en: A customer asked about under PDPO.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「under PDPO」。

examples.en: The briefing covered PDPO rules.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「PDPO rules」。

examples.en: A customer asked about PDPO of Hong Kong.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「PDPO of Hong Kong」。

examples.en: PDPO is why we hide numbers on receipts in photos.
examples.tc: 因為私隱條例，我們在相片收據隱藏號碼。

examples.en: A PDPO question should go to the manager, not a guess.
examples.tc: 私隱條例問題應問經理，不要猜。

senses.glossEn: To look through a system for a word or record.
senses.glossTc: 在系統中尋找字詞或紀錄。

examples.en: Search the sheet for yesterday's refund.
examples.tc: 在試算表搜尋昨天的退款。

examples.en: Search by order number, not by first name only.
examples.tc: 用訂單編號搜尋，不要只憑名字。

examples.en: I will search for this once the queue is shorter.
examples.tc: 排隊短一點，我就會「search for」。

examples.en: I searched my phone for the supplier's FPS.
examples.tc: 我在手機搜尋供應商的轉數快。

examples.en: We can search this after the next customer.
examples.tc: 服務下一位顧客後，我們可以「search」。

senses.glossEn: A timed list of what a system did.
senses.glossTc: 系統做過甚麼的連時間清單。

examples.en: A customer asked about the log of this.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「the log of」。

examples.en: The briefing covered error log.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「error log」。

examples.en: A customer asked about in the log.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「in the log」。

examples.en: The till log shows the freeze at 12:04.
examples.tc: 收銀紀錄顯示十二時四分凍結。

examples.en: Send the log to the helpdesk.
examples.tc: 把紀錄寄給支援台。

senses.glossEn: A file sent with a message.
senses.glossTc: 連同訊息寄出的檔案。

examples.en: Do not open an attachment from an unknown sender.
examples.tc: 不要打開陌生寄件人的附件。

examples.en: Today's notes mention see attachment.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「see attachment」。

examples.en: Can you open the attachment for the afternoon team?
examples.tc: 你可以替下午的同事「open the attachment」嗎？

examples.en: The invoice is in the attachment.
examples.tc: 發票在附件。

examples.en: WhatsApp compressed the attachment; send a PDF instead.
examples.tc: WhatsApp 壓縮了附件，改寄 PDF。

senses.glossEn: A document file that looks the same on most devices.
senses.glossTc: 在大多數裝置上看來相同的文件檔。

examples.en: Save the licence as a PDF.
examples.tc: 把牌照存成 PDF。

examples.en: Today's notes mention a PDF of this.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「a PDF of」。

examples.en: A customer asked about PDF file.
examples.tc: 有顧客問及「PDF file」。

examples.en: The till cannot open that PDF.
examples.tc: 收銀機打不開那個 PDF。

examples.en: I read the PDF on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上讀 PDF。

senses.glossEn: A small stick or port used to move files or attach devices.
senses.glossTc: 用來移動檔案或接裝置的小棒或接口。

examples.en: Today's notes mention a USB stick.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「a USB stick」。

examples.en: Write USB port on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「USB port」寫在白板上。

examples.en: The briefing covered on the USB.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「on the USB」。

examples.en: The backup USB stays in the safe.
examples.tc: 備份 USB 留在保險箱。

examples.en: Do not plug an unknown USB into the till.
examples.tc: 不要把不明 USB 插入收銀機。

senses.glossEn: The stored power inside a phone, scanner, or laptop.
senses.glossTc: 手機、掃描器或手提電腦內儲存的電力。

examples.en: Charge the battery before the MTR ride.
examples.tc: 乘港鐵前先充電。

examples.en: Write the battery is on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「the battery is」寫在白板上。

examples.en: Write battery low on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把「battery low」寫在白板上。

examples.en: The scanner battery dies at lunch.
examples.tc: 掃描器電池午市就沒電。

examples.en: A swollen battery must leave the till area.
examples.tc: 膨脹電池必須離開收銀區。

senses.glossEn: The strength of a mobile or Wi-Fi connection.
senses.glossTc: 流動或無線網絡連接的強度。

examples.en: There is no signal in the stockroom.
examples.tc: 貨倉沒有訊號。

examples.en: Poor signal on the MTR delayed the OTP.
examples.tc: 港鐵訊號差令一次性密碼延遲。

examples.en: Step to the door if the signal is weak.
examples.tc: 若訊號弱，走到門口。

examples.en: Put signal on the afternoon list.
examples.tc: 把「signal」寫進下午清單。

examples.en: The team asked how signal works here: 流動或無線網絡連接的強度。
examples.tc: 同事問這裡的「signal」怎麼用：流動或無線網絡連接的強度。

senses.glossEn: A newer version of software offered to a device.
senses.glossTc: 提供給裝置的較新軟件版本。

examples.en: Today's notes mention an update for this.
examples.tc: 今天的備註提到「an update for」。

examples.en: The briefing covered software update.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「software update」。

examples.en: The briefing covered install the update.
examples.tc: 簡報談到「install the update」。

examples.en: The till update is waiting after closing.
examples.tc: 收銀更新正等候關門後安裝。

examples.en: Skip the optional update until Monday.
examples.tc: 可選更新留到星期一。
